title: Tell us the experience. We'll build the journey.
subtitle: Not a package. A Sinai story shaped entirely around you.
body: Curated experiences and made-to-order journeys, built from the places, partners and details WEEMAP actually trusts — never a generic itinerary with your name on it.
noExperiences: No Signature Experiences are published yet — the build-your-own brief below is always open.
noExperienceMatches: Nothing curated in this category yet.
invitationEyebrow: Or start from a blank page
invitationBody: An occasion, a strange itch, a trip nobody else has taken — tell us what you're imagining and a WEEMAP curator will shape it, in a few short questions.
itineraryNote: Dates arranged with you once a curator confirms your request.
buildBody: A handful of quick questions — no forms, no fine print. Tell us what you're picturing and a WEEMAP curator takes it from there.
buildSummaryEmpty: Your answers will build up here as you go.
stepExperienceHint: A feeling, a place, an activity — however you'd describe it to a friend.
stepExperiencePlaceholder: e.g. a slow week of diving and desert camps, away from anywhere touristy…
stepTravelersHint: A rough headcount is enough for now.
stepWhenHint: No fixed date yet? That's completely fine.
stepVibeHint: Both optional — they just help your curator shape the first suggestion.
pacePacked: Packed — see and do as much as possible
stepContactHint: Your curator will follow up on WhatsApp — nowhere else, no spam.
requestSent: Sent — a WEEMAP curator will reach out on WhatsApp shortly.
requestSentBody: We've got everything you told us. Next, a curator reviews it and messages you on WhatsApp with a first shape for your trip and how payment works once you confirm.
requestFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again or reach us on WhatsApp.
notice: This is a request, not an instant confirmation — nothing is charged online.
